idea-plugin.name: Git Merge Into Plus
idea-plugin.description:
Merges the current branch into a target branch of your choice and automatically switches back to the current branch when the operation finishes.

Features:

  • Official Plugin Branding: Modern SVG plugin icons for light and dark IDE themes.
  • Searchable Branch Picker: Quickly filter and pick target branches, ideal for repositories with many branches.
  • Real-Time Branch Counter: Live badge displaying branch totals, favorite stars, and dynamic match counts as you filter.
  • Favorites Pinned to Top: Star frequently merged branches to keep them pinned at the top of the list.
  • Pre-Merge Divergence Intelligence: Real-time status calculating commits to merge (ahead), branch divergence (behind), fast-forward possibility, and an unambiguous Up to date badge.
  • Pre-Merge Remote Sync: Optional Update target branch from remote before merging safely fast-forwards the target branch from its remote tracking branch prior to merging.
  • Target Branch Commit Preview: Instant preview of the latest commit (hash, author, date, subject) on any selected target branch.
  • Custom Merge Commit Message: Specify an optional custom commit message when --no-ff is enabled; falls back to Git standard message if left blank.
  • Smart Memory: Remembers the last merged target branch for each repository.
  • Persistent Options: Remembers your --no-ff, push, and pull preferences across invocations.
  • Safe Checkout-Back: Automatically switches back to your original branch after merge, even if an error or conflict occurs.
  • Quick Shortcuts & Menu Icon: Accessible via Git → Merge Into... with official Git merge icon or shortcut (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+M / Cmd+Opt+Shift+M).
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.6

  • Pre-Merge Divergence Intelligence: Real-time check displaying incoming commits to merge (ahead), divergence metrics (behind), and an unambiguous Up to date status indicator.
  • Pre-Merge Remote Target Synchronization: Added option to automatically fast-forward the target branch from its remote tracking branch before merging.

0.1.5

  • Custom Merge Commit Message: Added an optional commit message input field activated when --no-ff is checked, supporting custom formats or falling back to Git defaults.
  • Real-Time Branch Counter & Fast Filter: Displays real-time branch and star counts in the search bar, updating dynamically as you filter.

0.1.4

  • Official Plugin Branding: Added official pluginIcon.svg and pluginIcon_dark.svg for the IDE Plugin Manager and JetBrains Marketplace.

0.1.3

  • Dedicated Action Icon: Added official Git merge icon to Git → Merge Into... in menus for instant visual recognition.
  • Target Branch Commit Preview: Displays real-time preview of the latest commit on the selected branch before merging.

0.1.2

  • Dynamic Plugin (Hot-Swapping) Support: Fixed extension point registration so the plugin can be installed, updated, and unloaded dynamically without restarting the IDE.
  • Internal Cleanup: Migrated notifications to modern NotificationGroupManager and added automated test for dynamic unloadability.

0.1.1

  • Remember Merge Options: Automatically saves and restores your --no-ff and push preferences (default: enabled).
  • Bug Fix: Fixed an issue where the default-selected branch could not be immediately confirmed without first switching to another branch.
  • UI & Metadata: Updated author details and enhanced plugin overview.

0.1.0

  • Initial release.
